ns2:course.label: Prof Issues for Teachers
ns2:course.description: (EOL 350) Provides the basic common understanding of schools as social organizations and the professional role of teachers in public schools; analyzes selected legal issues relating to student rights, employment and teacher rights, and collective bargaining in schools; and serves as an introduction to instructional supervision, teacher evaluation, and continuing professional development of teachers. Concurrent enrollment in EDPR 432 or EDPR 442. Prerequisite: Admission into a teacher preparation program.
